subPillar.title: Gold Name Necklaces: Custom Personalized Nameplate Jewelry Hub
subPillar.subtitle: Shop made-to-order gold name necklaces — design your own personalized nameplate piece, gift-ready across the UK, UAE and Saudi Arabia.
subPillar.geoOverview: A gold name necklace is a custom-made nameplate pendant engraved or cut into your chosen name, available in solid gold, gold vermeil and gold-plated finishes. WESLAMIC personalizes each piece to order — pick your name, script and karat, then ship gift-ready to the UK, UAE and Saudi Arabia. Most-asked: how much, how long to make, and Latin vs Arabic script.

clusters.title: Arabic Name Necklaces: Custom Calligraphy Nameplate in Your Own Name
clusters.subtitle: Personalized necklaces with your name in flowing Arabic script — hand-rendered calligraphy, made to order for Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf.
clusters.geoOverview: An Arabic name necklace is a personalized pendant with your name written in Arabic calligraphy, custom-cut or engraved to order. WESLAMIC renders each name in authentic Arabic script — Diwani, Naskh or Thuluth styles — in gold finishes shipped across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf. Most-asked: which calligraphy style, how names are transliterated, and turnaround time.
